searchText: what would the ssz length limits be for `beacon_blocks_by_range/root` rpc responses? with https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2686 , the max size of the beacon block could go much higher than `MAX_RPC_SIZE`, so seems like there's no type specific length upper bound for a post merge `SignedBeaconBlock`. Should we just consider it a special case and hardcode the `upper_bound = MAX_RPC_SIZE`? yes, taht is the intention. It should be the min of either the network or type specific bounds the 10MB is a sanity bound within gas limits (and growth) for a multi-year time horizon and what is in geth today (max block size is more like 2MB right now) most types will have more restrictive bounds than 10MB and those should be respected 👍
